description: This file defines the BasketService class, which manages shopping basket operations such as adding items, deleting baskets, setting item quantities, and transferring baskets between users within an e-commerce application.

classes.name: BasketService
classes.description: Service class implementing basket-related operations, such as adding items, setting quantities, transferring baskets, and deleting baskets within the application's core logic.

methods.name: AddItemToBasket
methods.description: Adds an item to the user's basket, creates a new basket if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: DeleteBasketAsync
methods.description: Deletes a basket given its ID.

methods.name: SetQuantities
methods.description: Sets the quantities of items in a basket based on provided dictionary mapping.

methods.name: TransferBasketAsync
methods.description: Transfers items from an anonymous basket to a user's basket, deleting the anonymous basket after transfer.
